8.20000,46.80000.desc: A decision on a living modified organism, filed by the country itself to the Biosafety Clearing-House. -81.60100,30.28730.name: Assisted Fertility Program
-81.60100,30.28730.desc: A fertility clinic reporting to the CDC's National ART Surveillance System. Medical director: Marwan M. Shaykh, MD. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. Reporting is required of every US clinic performing assisted reproduction, under the Fertility Clinic Success Rate and Certification Act, so this is close to a complete register rather than a list of members. What it records is cycles started, which is not the same as children born.

16.30509,48.07881.name: Institute for Veterinary Medicine (AGES Mödling)
16.30509,48.07881.company: Austrian Agency for Health and Food Safety
16.30509,48.07881.desc: A BSL3+ laboratory, operational. Run by Austrian Agency for Health and Food Safety. It is categorised as a public health laboratory, working on both human and animal health. It stands in a built-up area, with more than fifty thousand people living within two and a half miles. There is no international register of laboratories at this containment level and no obligation to declare one, so this record comes from a research project rather than a regulator. What that project could not find out is absent here too.

-77.03500,38.90500.name: BIO — Biotechnology Innovation Organization
-77.03500,38.90500.state: Washington DC — 1201 New York Ave NW
-77.03500,38.90500.desc: The largest biotechnology trade association in the world, representing over a thousand companies. Trade bodies exist so that positions no single company wants attributed to it can still be advanced — and companies route most of their political money this way, so it is the association’s name, not the member’s, that appears in lobbying registers and lawsuits.

139.70100,35.65800.name: CLEA Japan / Japan SLC
139.70100,35.65800.desc: Japan’s principal laboratory-animal suppliers, serving a research system whose scale is comparable to Europe’s. Japan publishes no national count of animals used, so the size of the practice there is inferred from the suppliers rather than reported by anyone — a reminder that the US and UK figures on this map exist because those countries chose to collect them, not because collecting them is normal.

-74.40000,40.79000.name: Zoetis
-74.40000,40.79000.desc: The largest animal health company in the world, spun out of Pfizer, selling vaccines and medicines for livestock and pets. Animal health products are how intensive production is sustained, which puts this company upstream of the conditions that edited disease resistance is designed to tolerate.

114.30000,30.60000.name: Bt63 rice — unapproved GM rice in food products and exports
114.30000,30.60000.type: Rice, unapproved variety in food chain
114.30000,30.60000.size: Detected in exports to Europe over many years
114.30000,30.60000.desc: Unapproved GM rice was found in food products and exports from China, traced to research material that had reached farmers. Rice is a staple eaten directly, which makes the food-safety argument here less abstract than for feed crops.

-43.17600,-22.90600.name: BNDES — bioeconomy lending
-43.17600,-22.90600.state: Rio de Janeiro — Av. República do Chile 100
-43.17600,-22.90600.desc: Brazil’s development bank, a large lender to agriculture, ethanol and industrial biotechnology. State credit rather than venture capital is what built the engineered-crop economy in Brazil, and it does not appear in any count of biotechnology investment.
